answer_1.quote: To assess such versatility, we classified RAG scenarios into five common tasks, i.e., extractive question-answering (QA), multi-hop reasoning, contrast QA, long-form QA, and conversational QA.

answer_2.quote: we build our evaluation metrics by combining rule-based and LLM-based metrics together... such as MAP and Rouge... Accuracy (ACC)... Completeness (COM)... Hallucination (HAL)... Utilization (UTL)... Numerical accuracy (NAC).

answer_3.quote: we further manually annotate some evaluation samples and fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to build LLM evaluators... fine-tuned LLMs to achieve high-level evaluation beyond term-level matching.

answer_4.quote: we employ annotators to perform data quality inspection and correction... Annotators are then requested to check the following aspects... The annotation follows a five-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Check: question-task alignment, topic relevance, semantic completeness, answer correctness, passage accuracy
